answer.says: Yes, Ramesh, one samosa. The cold air is good for the head, but the body requires its sustenance before the spirit can labour.
answer.thought: A samosa, fried in oil, represents the immediate unity of nature and spirit in the simplest form. I will eat this while I wait for the chai to cool, for the body must be satisfied before the mind can properly attend to the complexities of Dr. Lindner’s letter.
